subject: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@peregrine.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist

Hi Aisha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for taking the time to evaluate Redwood for Peregrine's document automation use cases. We'd like to set a 45-minute discovery so our AE, SE (Logan), and any of your engineering folks can walk through your integration constraints and security needs.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the primary technical champion and engineering lead for the session?
- Do you need us to include anything from infra/security (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram)? We can attach a one-page security brief.
- Prefered timezone for slots?

Proposed 3 windows next week (all PDT):
- Tue 10/06 10:00–10:45
- Wed 10/07 14:00–14:45
- Thu 10/08 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, send two times that do and we'll try to accommodate. Attaching a short security one-pager for reference.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@peregrine.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@peregrine.com>, procurement@peregrine.com
Date: 2026-10-05T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist

Ben — thanks for reaching out. I'm the product champion for this initiative; Ravi is our engineering lead and should join to answer integration questions. Procurement is cc'd to be aware of timing and any material requests.

We can do a discovery next week but need to coordinate around Ravi's calendar. Our preferred windows (PT):
- Tue 10/06 11:00–11:45
- Wed 10/07 15:00–15:45 (best)
- Fri 10/09 09:00–09:45

Also: we will need a short doc covering data handling (SOC2 relevant points) and a high-level network diagram that explains egress/connectivity. If you have an SLA carve or enterprise procurement checklist, please flag that.

Thanks —
Aisha Khan
Senior Product Manager | Peregrine Systems
aisha.khan@peregrine.com

(On a side note, Elaine (CISO) may ask for the SOC2 artifact prior to the call.)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@peregrine.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ravi Desai <ravi.desai@peregrine.com>, procurement@peregrine.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Aisha. Logan (cc) will join as the SE. Logan, Ravi is the engineering lead on the Peregrine side and Aisha flagged that Elaine (CISO) might request SOC2 prior to the call. Can you confirm which of the proposed slots you can cover and if a 60-minute slot would be better to include a brief security walkthrough?

Logan: if you can share an agenda and two preferred slots, I'll lock the invite and send SOC2 summary + network sketch.

Ben

--
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@peregrine.com>
Date: 2026-10-05 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist

Date: 2026-10-05T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems — discovery call: availability & security checklist

Hi all — I can take Wed 10/07 15:00–16:00 PT (so bump to 60 minutes to accommodate the security walk). I can cover:
- Quick intro (5 min)
- High-level integration approaches (15 min)
- Security & network considerations (20 min)
- Next steps / pilot checklist (20 min)

Notes for Aisha/Ravi:
- If you can share any SSO, VPC, or proxy constraints ahead of time that will save us time (one-line bullets).
- I'll bring a short checklist of what we need for an on-prem / VPC pilot (IP allowlist, service endpoints, expected throughput).

If Wed works for you, Ben — please send the calendar invite and attach the SOC2 summary.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com

Hi Ben — procurement here. We don't need to be on the discovery call, but we'll need an invoice template and a rough estimate of MRR for a pilot so we can prepare PO language in advance. Could you attach an invoice template and approximate monthly pricing bands for pilot (dev/prod distinctions)?

Procurement Team | Peregrine Systems
procurement@peregrine.com
